properties.author: Alexander Kürthy

independent_border_validation.method: Natural Earth international boundaries >0.22 degrees away from coast; not used in fitting; nearest pale raster boundary pixels; only unsaturated grey base regions sampled

properties.adaptation: Hue-based extraction of current seasonal colors; inverse Mercator registration; 3px closing of printed border gaps; 0.45px contour simplification; components smaller than 4 source pixels omitted; antimeridian split.
